slides.sub: Dasha + Gochar + Varga, step by step.

slides.body: A rule-based app checks one or two placements and prints a line. Real reading holds many layers at the same time.
The dasha (planetary period system) tells which planet's themes are active in your life right now. It sets the stage.
Gochar (current planetary transit) shows what is passing over your chart today. It is the timing trigger inside the stage.
Varga (divisional charts such as D-9 and D-10) test whether a promise in the main chart has real strength in a specific area of life.

points: Start with the active dasha lord
Check how that planet sits in D-1 and the relevant varga

slides.body: Holding all these layers by hand is slow and error-prone. AI computes them fast. The astrologer's judgment still decides.
